- As of my knowledge, Swiss unemployment in 2024 was around 2.3-2.6% depending on the measure (SECO registered unemployment vs. ILO definition).
- Economic forecasts around my cutoff suggested Swiss unemployment would rise slightly in 2025 (to maybe 2.7-3%) due to slower growth, franc strength, SNB rate cuts, etc.

But there's real uncertainty. Also possible economic conditions improve with SNB rate cuts boosting growth, which could lower unemployment by 2026.
